systems.country_label: Kebele ID System / Kebele ID Card
systems.tiers: local kebele ID, named as Ethiopia's foundational ID credential surveyed between 11 September 2024 and 22 January 2025; no digital ID coded for Ethiopia
scaling up registration nationwide; not captured by the survey

note: A global identity-coverage dataset report. For Ethiopia it gives adult ID ownership (91 per cent, on the kebele ID) and lists the country among those furthest behind on under-5 birth registration, without a figure; it says nothing about how or where births and deaths are registered, so no fact is recorded.
